title: Identity Crisis | ECHO//100 Episode 17
description:
Kavi faces his own shadow as the true architect of the loop is finally unmasked. Mira seizes control of the timeline, trapping the rivals in a void of her own design. Episode 17 of ECHO//100: The Missing Hour. This is a work of original fiction generated with AI assistance.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The void fractures, and suddenly, two identical Kavis stand shivering in the humming white silence.
scenes.caption: Two identical Kavis
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, two Kavis in red hoodies and glasses staring at each other in a glowing white void.

scenes.text: Null shifts, his black-purple glitch skin molding perfectly into Kavi’s red hoodie and signature backpack.
scenes.caption: Null mimics Kavi
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Null’s body turning into a perfect replica of Kavi, red eyes glowing intensely.

scenes.text: They trade identical glares, each claiming the True Timeline belongs to their own fractured, lonely reality.
scenes.caption: Battle of wits
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, two Kavis chest-to-chest, the real Kavi clutching his backpack, Null smirking.

scenes.text: Kavi shouts that he never wanted the door, revealing he was coerced by a darker influence.
scenes.caption: The forced architect
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Kavi shouting at the empty air, Byte hovering anxiously in the background.

scenes.text: Mira descends, her blue holographic teal coat flickering with the cold authority of a puppet master.
scenes.caption: Mira arrives
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Mira floating down with a cold expression, her teal coat flowing like digital smoke.

scenes.text: She laughs, admitting she manipulated Kavi’s future self to ensure the endless loop never truly ends.
scenes.caption: Mira’s dark reversal
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Mira pointing at Kavi, her eyes glowing with malicious, calculated intent.

scenes.text: Byte tries to intervene, but Mira silences his orange antenna with a single, sharp digital gesture.
scenes.caption: Byte is silenced
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Byte frozen in mid-air, his orange antenna dimming as Mira’s hand closes.

scenes.text: The floor vanishes, sealing Kavi and Null forever in a pristine, inescapable, and windowless white prison.
scenes.caption: Trapped in white
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Kavi and Null standing on a dissolving platform within a vast, empty white room.
